# Long FFT Experiment Tables

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_long_fft_tables.py; edit the manifest instead. -->

These are predeclared test conditions and empty result templates, not benchmark results.
`planned` means the required implementation or runner is not available. Even a runnable
experiment remains `not measured` until raw trials and correctness evidence are collected.

See [the experiment plan](../benchmarks/long-fft-plan.md) for hypotheses and execution policy.

## E01: Legal length and memory envelope

**Status:** planned. **Purpose:** Segmented execution extends C2C beyond the single-AIV UB limit without hiding boundary storage costs.

**Shape rule:** {"batches": [1], "ns": [2048, 4096, 8192, 16384, 32768, 65536, 131072, 262144, 524288, 1048576]}

**Controls:** ["fp32 forward C2C", "dense layout", "available-memory budget", "reference policy"]

**Baselines:** ["Current single-AIV implementation: unsupported reference, never timed as a long-FFT baseline", "Available CANN/native long C2C with matched semantics"]

**Required evidence:** ["support-envelope.csv", "allocation-budget.csv", "correctness-trials.csv", "rejections.csv"]

**Acceptance:** ["65536 and all declared supported lengths pass every trial", "Unsupported or memory-infeasible points produce explicit reasons", "No hidden truncation or padding"]

## E02: Single-transform and low-batch latency

**Status:** planned. **Purpose:** Long FFT decomposition provides competitive latency while exposing setup and launch overhead separately.

**Shape rule:** {"batches": [1, 4, 16], "ns": [8192, 16384, 32768, 65536, 131072, 262144, 524288, 1048576]}

**Controls:** ["transform contract", "warmup/repeat", "placement", "randomized baseline order"]

**Baselines:** ["Ascend FFT fixed legal segmented mapping", "Ascend FFT model-selected mapping", "Ascend FFT measured-search mapping", "Available CANN/native long C2C with matched semantics"]

**Required evidence:** ["raw-trials.csv", "latency-summary.csv", "latency-by-length.svg", "selected-configs.json"]

**Acceptance:** ["All 24 semantic shapes reported including failures and regressions", "Model and measured-search results are separately identified", "No universal speedup requirement is imposed"]

## E03: Equal total points across FFT lengths

**Status:** planned. **Purpose:** At equal total work, variation with FFT length reveals dependency, boundary and steady-state costs rather than merely data volume.

**Shape rule:** {"fixed_total_points": [1048576, 16777216, 67108864], "ns": [4096, 8192, 16384, 32768, 65536, 131072, 262144, 524288, 1048576]}

**Controls:** ["N times batch", "transform contract", "memory budget", "timing scope"]

**Baselines:** ["Ascend FFT fixed legal segmented mapping", "Ascend FFT model-selected mapping", "Ascend FFT measured-search mapping", "Available CANN/native long C2C with matched semantics"]

**Required evidence:** ["raw-trials.csv", "equal-work-summary.csv", "throughput-by-length.svg", "traffic-by-length.svg"]

**Acceptance:** ["Each row satisfies N times batch equals its declared total_points", "Each equal-work series reports all eight lengths", "Large-memory cases are explicitly skipped when budget is insufficient"]

## E04: Batch saturation and mapping breakpoints

**Status:** planned. **Purpose:** Resident subgraph reuse amortizes fixed overhead but steady-state throughput depends on role balance and hardware-resource breakpoints.

**Shape rule:** {"batches": [1, 4, 16, 32, 47, 48, 49, 64, 95, 96, 97, 128, 143, 144, 145, 191, 192, 193, 256, 512, 1024], "ns": [16384, 65536, 262144]}

**Hardware note:** 48D +/- 1 batches are provisional Ascend910_9382 controls for D=1..4. Recompute for the local AIV count and legal long-FFT mappings.

**Controls:** ["N within each series", "hardware profile", "candidate budget", "placement", "memory budget"]

**Baselines:** ["Ascend FFT fixed legal segmented mapping", "Ascend FFT model-selected mapping", "Available CANN/native long C2C with matched semantics"]

**Required evidence:** ["raw-trials.csv", "saturation-summary.csv", "throughput-by-batch.svg", "mapping-breakpoints.csv"]

**Acceptance:** ["65536 has all declared batch values", "Mapping changes and tails are recorded rather than smoothed away", "Hardware-dependent breakpoints are not claimed universal"]

| `transform` | C2C, R2C or C2R; direction and normalization must also be recorded. |
| `precision` | Input, output and accumulation precision. |
| `direction` | Forward or inverse; never combine incompatible transform directions. |
| `normalization` | Exact normalization applied to the output. |
| `placement` | In-place or out-of-place, including any required copy. |
| `layout` | Dense/strided layout and output order; compare identical data contracts. |
| `timing_scope` | Device-only, host end-to-end, plan setup or first use; compare identical scopes. |
| `application_id` | Predeclared workload proxy identifier, or an explicit not-applicable value. |
| `input_mode` | Numerical input pattern or application proxy generator. |
| `seed` | Recorded random seed; use an explicit not-applicable value for analytical inputs. |
| `hardware` | Device identifier and hardware profile revision. |
| `software` | CANN, compiler and baseline library versions. |
| `revision` | Exact repository revision used to build the tested binary. |
| `implementation` | Exact library/backend and selected configuration, not a version label alone. |
| `configuration_id` | Stable mapping/core identifier shared with selected-configs.json and ablation pairs. |
| `selected_config` | Complete selected architecture mapping and processing-unit parameters. |
| `warmup` | Warmup executions excluded from steady-state timing. |
| `repeat` | Timed executions within the trial. |
| `trial` | Independent trial index; preserve every raw trial. |
| `status` | planned, passed, failed or unsupported; planned is not a measured result. |
| `gm_read_bytes` | Record the measured value and unit; leave blank before execution. |
| `gm_write_bytes` | Record the measured value and unit; leave blank before execution. |
